narr: Monsoon moisture increasing from the south brought thunderstorms across northern Arizona and southern Utah. Heavy Rain in Utah produced flash flooding in the Paria River that flows into Arizona.
ev: Monsoon moisture increasing from the south brought thunderstorms across northern Arizona. Heavy Rain in Utah produced flash flooding in the Paria River that flows into Arizona and the gauge near Lees Ferry rose from 4.4 feet to 6.3 feet at 4:30 AM MST.
lsr: PARIA RIVER GAUGE AT LEES FERRY ROSE FROM 4.4FT TO 6.3FT AT 4:30AM MST. FLOOD WATERS LIKELY FLOWED DOWN THE PARIA OVERNIGHT, FROM HEAVY RAINS UPSTREAM THE PREVIOUS AFTERNOON.
